scope: Whole ordinary DarkCreature.Load with exact saved transform, state, resource/ref order, own model/material/bones, wind and Marker dependency calls and final rail assertions. ResourceManager, actual Model/Animation/Wind/Marker owners and SwitchRail geometry remain explicit services. This loader does not complete patrol/attack/collision, autonomous drawing, network or unload lifecycle. Full caller memory and ordered services compared. Original options padding is excluded from service snapshots; every explicitly initialized byte is compared. Missing textures/observations/bones, prior bone fields, degenerate scales, saved flags and late rail assertions are covered.
